## Architecture Principles
<!-- Declarative, testable rules. Defaults, unless the team overrode them at init:
- Layered / Clean Architecture: the domain layer MUST have zero infrastructure dependencies
- Bounded contexts: each context owns its aggregates; cross-context access via contracts only
- No business logic in HTTP entry points; no direct DB queries outside repositories
- One aggregate modified per command; cross-aggregate changes via domain events
Add here, if the team required command idempotency:
- Command Handler Idempotency: REQUIRED — every command carries commandId (UUID v4); the handler
  checks it against a dedup store before executing; a duplicate returns the cached result
Add here, if the system has a messaging context:
- Transactional Outbox: REQUIRED — events published inside a command handler are written to the
  outbox in the same transaction as the state change; no dual-write -->
